run_benchmark: run a vLLM startup benchmark with serve and startup parameter overrides and output results to JSON
run_comb: run multiple benchmark iterations for a single serve and startup parameter combination
run_combs: run all serve and startup parameter combinations and export results to a CSV summary
run_main: run the full startup parameter sweep experiment with CLI-derived arguments
SweepStartupArgs_from_cli_args: parse CLI arguments into a SweepStartupArgs dataclass with parameter filtering and validation
